name: io.github.cubicecho/mcp-zeromem
description: Zero-token conversational memory for agents: turns go into one SQLite store and come back through recall with no LLM in the loop.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ZEROMEM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token clients must send to /mcp. Required unless SECURE_LOCAL_NET=true.

environmentVariables.name: ZEROMEM_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (remember, ingest, forget) from clients.

environmentVariables.name: ZEROMEM_RECALL_TEXT_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Characters per turn before zeromem_recall's text format clips and marks the cut (default 2000). The JSON format is never clipped.

environmentVariables.name: ZEROMEM_EMBEDDER
environmentVariables.description: auto (default), onnx, hash or none. auto downloads bge-small-en-v1.5 on first use and falls back to hashing, loudly, if it cannot.

environmentVariables.name: ZEROMEM_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Session id to leave out of zeromem_recall by default, so recall does not echo the current conversation.
